changes.what: Stills (Check light & colour, Remove green, Save grade reference)
changes.before: with proxies on, Premiere drew the still from the 1080p proxy (upscaled), so grade references in Final Output / Stills and light measurements came from the proxy
changes.now: proxies switch off for each capture and back on after, so every still is the original media (checked with a marked proxy: none of it in the still)

changes.before: How to use had no proxy step
changes.now: How to use › Proxies step; new Proxies & output section: what uses the proxy (playback) and what always uses the original (grade, stills, export)

changes.before: 4K–8K footage (8K HEVC 4:2:2 above all) played back choppy; proxies had to be made by hand in Media Encoder and attached clip by clip
changes.now: Make proxies: a 1080p ProRes Proxy for every 4K+ clip in the open project, made on Apple's media engines, saved in the client's Proxies folder, attached and switched on; exports still use the originals
on by default: clips dropped into any project, or imported by a build, get their proxy by themselves (checked every 20 s)

changes.before: a short Workflow list that still described the audio-only trim
changes.now: a How to use dropdown at the top of About: the 8 steps from client folder to verified export, matching docs/how-to-start.md on GitHub

changes.before: Standalone described as audio-only trim
changes.now: describes face-checked trim and learned starting values (since 1.8.0)

changes.before: a spoken count-in ("three, two, one") counted as part of the take
changes.now: descending count-ins are ignored and flagged on the clip; a start that moves by more than 0.1 s after ignoring talk is applied

changes.before: audio only: first and last sound
changes.now: same engine as Claude mode when its packages are installed: transcript (slates and crew talk ignored) + audio + face (frontal, still, mouth closed, eyes open), 10 s look-back, OUT 0.5 s earlier; audio trim stays as the fallback

changes.before: person did not move but no frame passed the strict test: IN/OUT jumped up to 7.6 s inside the talk
changes.now: best frame of the pause is used and flagged REVIEW; vertical 8K clips decode small (no out-of-memory); ffmpeg capped at 4 threads

changes.before: one house grade for every clip
changes.now: house grade plus learned priors per setup (office, green screen, outdoor), Exposure limited to ±0.6; Check light & colour sets the final values

changes.before: priors and the OUT rule added by hand per client
changes.now: built into the engine: priors once, OUT −0.5 s (never closer than 0.15 s after the last word), group per clip

changes.before: no face-trim packages
changes.now: installs mediapipe + faster-whisper into ~/.lumacut_deps (optional, never blocks)

changes.before: exposure and colour came from the plan or a fixed preset, never checked on the graded picture
changes.now: Check light & colour: exports each clip's graded frame, measures face brightness, highlights and skin colour, sets Exposure / Highlights / Temperature / Tint to match your approved grade references per setup, then re-measures (up to 3 rounds); outdoor VG keeps Temp −4…+8, Tint −2…+4

changes.before: every review was saved under the client folder picked in Build, so reviews of different clients merged and no rule switched on
changes.now: saved under the client of the open project; the 24 Nov reviews are moved back to AC#6, AC#7 and AC#8 once and the rules rebuilt

changes.before: saved into the Build client's Final Output
changes.now: saved into the open project's client Final Output

changes.before: no update history
changes.now: New updates: every version with its date, time and what changed

changes.before: Cmd+Z did nothing while the panel had focus
changes.now: Undo and Redo buttons in the header; Cmd+Z / Shift+Cmd+Z work inside the panel too (Premiere's own undo)

changes.before: typed by hand, written with Apply
changes.now: written once at the end of Build (skin Hue +3.5 Sat +3, green Sat +5)

changes.before: Skin / green rows + Apply saved, closed and reopened the project
changes.now: fully live: nothing closes, Cmd+Z works; per-clip skin / green in Premiere's Color tab

changes.before: Over / Normal / Under, also filled skin and green
changes.now: Over / Under, Lumetri only, live

changes.before: copied Overall + skin + green (green / skin needed a reopen)
changes.now: copies Overall only, live

changes.before: filled the skin / green rows, Apply pasted to the scope
changes.now: clipboard card + Paste to selected clips button (source clip skipped)

changes.before: warm graphite + copper
changes.now: shared design with Smart Export: charcoal, #FA914F accent, icons

changes.before: All sequences / Current sequence / Selected clip
changes.now: all sequences only, one button

changes.before: skipped by file name ' (1)'
changes.now: checked by content (hash, sound, pictures); different takes are kept

changes.before: Previous / Next flag, Check my changes + Confirm review, Save image + Save grade sample
changes.now: Flagged by system / All clips, click selects the clip, one Final check & save learning, one Save grade reference

changes.before: grew without limit
changes.now: keeps the last 3 batches (About: 1 / 3 / 5), max 10 MB; rules need 2 batches

changes.before: last word + 0.6 s, even into a breath
changes.now: stops 0.1 s before the next sound
